_comment: Mission and audience per PROPOSAL family (first match on the frame name wins). The judge panel reads these; add a brief when a new proposal family lands. Personas: intended-user, premium-critic, buyer, heritage-manager. claims:false = product frame showing the user's own data; the marketing claims-ledger check is skipped.

defaults.audience: an independent artist or their manager using Jovie
defaults.mission: make the next step obvious and trustworthy in one glance

briefs.surface: Jovie Network: the artist's music-industry CRM built from Gmail headers and release credits
briefs.audience: an independent artist or manager who emails producers, writers, engineers, managers and A&R
briefs.mission: see who you already make music with, by role, and invite each collaborator one at a time without it feeling like spam or surveillance
briefs.buyer: You would pay because this saves hours of contact admin and grows your network.
decisions: Invites are drafted by Jovie but opened and sent by the artist from their own Gmail, one at a time; Jovie never sends, nudges or follows up.
The empty state is intentional: it shows how to start an import, not missing data.
Credits shown to a recipient are only those Jovie is at least 90% sure of.

briefs.surface: Jovie golden-path onboarding: the chat shows a 'Building your profile' indicator while Jovie assembles the artist's profile
briefs.audience: an artist who just claimed their profile and is waiting for it to be built
briefs.mission: show honest progress so the artist trusts the wait and knows what they will get, without fake precision
briefs.buyer: You are deciding in your first minutes whether Jovie is worth paying for.
decisions: Progress shows exact counts (for example 2 of 14 releases) because the import is real and the artist can keep chatting while it runs.

briefs.surface: Jovie claim verification: proving you control an artist before a claimed profile goes public
briefs.audience: an artist or their manager claiming an artist profile on Jovie
briefs.mission: prove control quickly and safely so no impostor or fan account ever publishes a profile, without slowing first-use value
briefs.buyer: You would only pay if your act can never be impersonated on Jovie.
decisions: Verification starts with one-tap OAuth (Instagram, YouTube); the page stays private until verified, and a dispute freezes edits without taking the page offline.

briefs.surface: Jovie fan stories: a living story per fan, set up once by the artist, then always on inside rails
briefs.audience: an independent artist (or a fan, on the opt-in and email screens) using Jovie fan stories
briefs.mission: set the rails once, then trust Jovie to write to opted-in fans one story at a time, with one-tap pause and nothing that feels like spam
briefs.buyer: You would pay because fans hear from you every week without you running campaigns.
decisions: The artist sets rails once and never approves individual emails; the feed is for watching, with one-tap pause.
Fans are shown by pseudonym and coarse context only.
The artist and catalog on these frames are fictional by design.
